svg.aria-label: The architecture of the paper: a conventional byte level base model; two associative memory layers as an additional residual sub block, zero initialised; a router over the control and the two memories under three constraints, a guaranteed floor, a routing regime that follows consolidation, a fallback with hysteresis; versioned behind a stable interface; and the write path of the organ as a ledger of five rules with their words
svg.title: Figure 6. The architecture: a memory router on a non regression floor, and the organ's write path as a ledger
svg.text: The architecture: a memory router on a non regression floor, and the organ's write path as a ledger
quantum-cortex, original figure for section 3 of the paper. The base is kept conventional so that every departure from it is attributable to a single ablated component.
The base model, and one of its blocks
a byte level decoder only transformer trained from scratch, with a reserved block
of token identifiers for oracle events; the brain mapping a source of hypotheses, not a claim of fidelity

g.text: in each transformer block, an additional residual sub block: the associative memory,
two layers of one fast weight family, differing in whether the memory is static or written online

svg.text: a learned bank of key and value patterns
read by attention: a static, content
a per head recurrent state, an error
correcting rank one write, a per channel
forget gate, keys normalised: written online
both zero initialised at the output projection: the model begins as the control and learns the memory
The router over paths, the central proposal

g.text: the control, no memory
the static memory layer
the delta layer
not one memory, nor a fixed
choice: a router, per span
a guaranteed floor
a memory path is selected on a span only where its predicted score exceeds the control's; at worst the
router equals the control; falling to the control is recorded as a result, not a failure
the routing regime follows consolidation
soft where unsure (paths computed and mixed), hard where learned, confidently and stably (one path,
selected before computation); it migrates from soft to hard; an uncertain decision is never hardened
a fallback with hysteresis
on a path that degrades, the breaker re routes to the best remaining path above the control, or to the control,
and re softens the decision; a declared cooldown prevents oscillation between paths

svg.text: the router, versioned behind a stable interface
a first version, an oracle that reads the true per path scores and so computes the ceiling any learned router may reach; a second, a learned gate
predicting them from the span's context alone; the state serialised with a version tag and dispatched by version, so that later versions extend the interface without breaking earlier ones
The organ's write path as a ledger: five rules transposed from the author's parallel program in gravitation, none as a theorem, each checked against the code and given its word

g.text: one, the origin is stored at the write, never derived
the anchor is the scope, one journal per domain, and the time of the write, kept in every
entry; the "where" enters at the write and nowhere else, no local law returns it later. Satisfied.
two, two laws, not one
the conserved total by construction: states move one way, what is kept plus what has left equals
what was written, every phase writes the counts; no law for the shape of the defect, nothing is
derived on the text. One satisfied, one declared.
three, a drifting invariant breaks reconstruction
the scope's configuration, separation, sealing and policy are hashed together; a journal opened
under another separation is refused; a changed value at an address carrying its own source text is
a dated revision of the one entry, a new version with provenance rather than a drift; restated in
another text it opens a second entry, undecided which holds. Satisfied for the organ's invariants; declared for the user's.
four, a collision is a crossing, not a wall
two episodes that become indistinguishable are not resolved by deleting one against the other.
Satisfied in part; its completion at the write the identity rule (a write carrying a source text
is redundant only when that text is already stored byte for byte, an unsourced write staying under
the surprise gate; every near duplicate stored), at the read the selection (exact key first,
similarity second, a conflict of values exposed as an abstention), adopted as the system's policy;
in sample by design for the model's choice; on the sealed set the key acts where the templates read
the question, and the mark alone remains where none does
five, the defect sizes the hidden share but does not name it
at eviction the payload is released at its last pointer, by identity, and the event names the
pointer and never the content: from the visible record one knows how much has left and
which hashes, never what they said. Satisfied by construction.
the four words a level may carry
theorem; reconstructible at measured defect; backup; declared loss: consolidation and demotion
are a backup (the bytes stay by pointer), eviction is a declared loss; the second word was
earned on the organ's layer of numbers by a declared probe, not on its text
the memories
the router on its floor
the write path's rules
the base and the versioning
